lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point, with higher spot density observed in the lower-lateral quadrant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features exhibit a sharp vertical luminance transition (high-intensity upper edge, low-intensity lower shadow), running parallel to the longitudinal axis of the torso.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, thin linear feature (potential parasite or trailing line) is visible extending vertically from the dorsal midline above the primary flank section.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-luminance circular spots is visible on the posterior surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the main torso.
